name: DLIMS Punjab Verify, Track & E-License Download
author: niazi123

sections.description:
Looking for a quick way to verify your Punjab driving license, track your application status, or download your e-License online? This plugin is your answer. Visit TrafficSignsTest.com — Pakistan’s most trusted driving license preparation resource — for practice tests, traffic signs guides, fee calculators, and much more.

TrafficSignsTest Driving License Helper is a free, lightweight WordPress plugin that connects your website visitors directly to the official DLIMS Punjab (Driving License Information Management System) portal — now powered by Dastak, the Government of Punjab’s one-window service platform. With simple shortcodes and buttons, your visitors can instantly access three core DLIMS services:

  • ✅ Verify Driving License — Confirm whether a Punjab driving license is valid and authentic
  • ✅ Track Application — Check the real-time status of a driving license application
  • ✅ Download E-License — Access and download the digital copy of a Punjab driving license

This plugin is an independent, non-official tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Punjab, DLIMS, or Dastak. It is designed purely as a helper to guide WordPress website visitors to the correct official government portal.

What is DLIMS Punjab?

DLIMS stands for Driving License Information Management System, an official initiative of the Government of Punjab, Pakistan. It is an integrated component of the Dastak — One Window for all Government Services platform, which securely handles all driving license processes online including:

  • Online form submission for Learner License, Regular License, and International License
  • Driving license verification using CNIC or license number
  • Real-time application tracking
  • Secure PSID generation for fee payment via ATM, online banking, or mobile banking
  • E-License (digital driving license) download from your DLIMS/Dastak account

As of 2026, all DLIMS services have been fully migrated to the Dastak platform at dastak.punjab.gov.pk. This plugin provides direct shortcut buttons to the most frequently used DLIMS tools.

Why Use This Plugin?

Millions of people in Punjab search for information about their driving license every year. Whether someone wants to verify if their license is genuine, check how far along their application is, or download a digital copy for travel or job purposes — these are some of the most commonly searched topics on Pakistani driving license websites.

By adding this plugin to your WordPress site, you provide your visitors with a one-click solution to access these services instantly. No confusion, no searching — just clean, clearly labeled buttons that take them directly to the correct official page.

  • No coding required — Add shortcodes to any page or post
  • Mobile-friendly — Works perfectly on all screen sizes
  • Lightweight — No heavy scripts, no slowing down your site
  • Always up to date — Links point to official government URLs
  • Fully free — No premium version, no upsells

Plugin Features

1. Verify Driving License Button
Adds a button that takes visitors to the official DLIMS Punjab license verification page at dlims.punjab.gov.pk/verify. Users can enter their CNIC number or license number to confirm authenticity and validity.

2. Track Application Button
Adds a button to the official DLIMS application tracking page at dlims.punjab.gov.pk/track. Visitors who have applied for a new, renewal, or duplicate license can check their application progress in real time.

3. E-License Download Button
Adds a button directing visitors to the DLIMS e-License section at dlims.punjab.gov.pk/elicense. After completing payment and approval, applicants can download their digital driving license directly from their DLIMS/Dastak account.

4. Combined All-in-One Button Set
Use a single shortcode to display all three buttons together in a neat layout — perfect for dedicated driving license help pages.

5. Widget Support
Add any of the buttons to your sidebar, footer, or any widget area using the built-in WordPress widget.

How to Use

Show all three buttons (Verify + Track + E-License):
[dlims_helper]

Show only the Verify License button:
[dlims_helper show=”verify”]

Show only the Track Application button:
[dlims_helper show=”track”]

Show only the E-License Download button:
[dlims_helper show=”elicense”]

Custom button labels:
[dlims_helper verify_text=”Check License” track_text=”Track My Application” elicense_text=”Get My E-License”]

About DLIMS Punjab Services

Verify Driving License:
License verification is important for employers, traffic police, car rental companies, and individuals who want to confirm the authenticity of a driving license. The official DLIMS verification tool allows anyone to check if a Punjab driving license is genuine and currently valid by entering the CNIC number linked to it.

Track Driving License Application:
After applying for a new learner license, regular license, renewal, or duplicate license through DLIMS/Dastak, applicants often want to know the status of their application. The DLIMS tracking system provides real-time updates at every stage of the application process — from submission to dispatch.

E-License (Digital Driving License) Download:
DLIMS Punjab offers a fully digital driving license — the e-License. Once your application is approved and payment is confirmed, you can log into your DLIMS/Dastak account and download a digital copy of your driving license. This e-License is an official document that can be used for identification and driving purposes just like the physical card.

Step-by-Step Guide: How to Apply for a Punjab Driving License Online

  1. Create Account — Register at dlims.punjab.gov.pk or dastak.punjab.gov.pk
  2. Fill Application Form — Choose license category (Bike, Car, LTV, HTV, PSV) and fill all required details
  3. Upload Documents — Upload clear photos of CNIC (front and back) and a recent passport-size photo. Medical certificate required if above 50 years
  4. Generate PSID — A unique Public Service Identifier (PSID) is generated for payment
  5. Make Payment — Pay the fee (Rs. 500 per category) via ATM, internet banking, or mobile banking
  6. Download Learner License — Available instantly after payment confirmation in your account
  7. Get Regular License — After the learner period, apply for your regular driving license card

Frequently Asked Questions

What is DLIMS Punjab?

DLIMS stands for Driving License Information Management System — the official Punjab government system for all driving license services, now operated through Dastak.

How can I verify my Punjab driving license?

Use the Verify License button added by this plugin, which takes you to the official DLIMS verification page. Enter your CNIC to check your license status.

How do I track my driving license application?

Click the Track Application button to go directly to the DLIMS tracking page. You will need your CNIC or application reference number.

What is an e-License?

An e-License is a digital copy of your Punjab driving license. After your application is approved and payment is completed, you can download it from your DLIMS/Dastak account.

Is this plugin official?

No. This is an independent WordPress plugin that provides shortcut buttons to the official DLIMS Punjab government portal. It is not affiliated with the Government of Punjab or DLIMS.

Where can I prepare for my driving license test?

Visit TrafficSignsTest.com for free practice tests, traffic signs guides, e-challan checker, and fee calculators for Pakistan driving licenses.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, completely free with no hidden charges or premium upgrades.

More Resources

For complete driving license preparation in Pakistan, visit TrafficSignsTest.com:

  • Free traffic signs practice tests for Car, Motorcycle, LTV/HTV/PSV
  • Pakistan driving license fee calculator
  • E-Challan checker for Punjab
  • Complete guides for DLIMS online application
sections.installation:
1. Upload the trafficsignstest-driving-license-helper folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Add shortcode [dlims_helper] to any page or post
  4. Or go to Appearance → Widgets and add the DLIMS Helper widget to your sidebar
